Your Spotify connection expires soon
====================================

Spotify logins only last a fixed time. When this one runs out, spotify-tracker stops recording your listening history.

Re-authorize Spotify in the admin dashboard before then. It takes a few seconds.

Expires: 2026-11-16 09:00 UTC (in 7 days)
Token lifetime: 180-day limit

Re-authorize Spotify:
  https://listening.example.com/admin/settings/spotify

The poller picks up the new token automatically.

You get these because you're an alert recipient. Change it in Settings → Email alerts:
